description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'TopNavAdapter' for an Android app, implementing a RecyclerView adapter for a top navigation bar with focus handling for TV devices. It manages a list of navigation items including a special search icon token, and provides visual and focus behavior customizations.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter providing a list of top navigation tabs with focus handling for TV devices, including a special search item.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter.TopNavVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual top navigation items, managing focus, click behavior, and layout styling.

methods.name: TopNavAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a list of items and click callback.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates ViewHolder instances by inflating item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolder for a given position.

methods.name: TopNavVH.bind
methods.description: Binds a text item to the ViewHolder, configuring views for search icon or text, and setting focus and key handling.
